steps.name: step-01-discover-rmapi
steps.notes: rmapi v0.0.34 found at /opt/homebrew/bin/rmapi, already authenticated. Discovery required delegation to general-purpose agent — direct bash attempts failed. Pattern: always delegate tool discovery for external device CLIs.

steps.name: step-02-generate-pdf
steps.notes: Multiple iterations required. Key failures: (1) improving-pdf produced 7-page branded output — wrong tool for personal docs; use reportlab. (2) questions rendered as 3-column table caused text overflow and orphaned rows across pages; fix is plain numbered paragraphs. (3) font size 7pt unreadable on reMarkable — minimum 9pt. (4) visual check via pdftoppm+Read was the correct verification method and should be mandatory before every push.

steps.name: step-03-push-to-remarkable
steps.notes: Correct push pattern established: copy PDF to persistent path (OneDrive/IES), then rmapi put --force '<path>' /Meetings. /tmp does not persist across osascript calls. File naming: human-readable with spaces, no dates, no underscores (e.g. 'GeniusSpark Meeting Prep.pdf').

grading.grader_notes: Final output correct but required 8+ iterations and significant controller intervention. Pattern is now documented and repeatable. Grade reflects execution quality, not outcome.
